name: 01-woodland-hero
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural, photographic alternate based on an existing photograph.
Asset type: landscape portfolio hero photograph, ideally 3840 × 2160, highest available native resolution.
Input image 1 is the primary edit target: the actual Kagora light pavilion glowing amber in a misty forest. Input image 2 is a structural reference only, showing the same pavilion from its entrance.
Create an impressive but faithful photographic refinement of input 1. Keep the same real installation: four interwoven arch groups with multiple thin LED tube ribs, its low broad proportions and original pattern of crossings, grounded among these trees. Preserve the forest location, tree arrangement, blue ambient light on the left and warm amber/copper LED lighting. Level the photograph and crop in moderately so the complete pavilion occupies about 55–60% of the frame width; retain mist above it and a little dark foreground. Crisp accurately focused tubes, natural foliage and bark detail, clean shadows with subtle texture, carefully controlled highlights so individual luminous lines stay separate rather than blowing out to white. A sophisticated architectural night photograph, with depth and atmosphere, restrained natural contrast, no HDR halos. Preserve any visible people exactly as in the target; do not introduce people.
Do not redesign the structure, add tubes or ornamental architecture, enlarge the physical installation, change its number of arches, introduce lasers/stars/moon/text/logos, or produce a collage. This is an AI alternate for review, so prioritize faithful geometry over decorative invention. One complete landscape image.

name: 02-woven-entrance
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural, faithful photographic refinement.
Asset type: landscape architectural portfolio photograph, ideally 3840 × 2160, highest available native resolution.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the actual Kagora pavilion viewed from its entrance. Generate a refined alternate of this same photo with exceptional focus and optical clarity. Keep the existing arch geometry, thin tube thickness, woven crossings, door openings, ground-level supports, cushions and all visible people in their existing positions. Retain the cyan, blue, emerald and small coral/violet light transitions seen in the reference.
Compose a level frontal landscape image with a slightly tighter, balanced crop, keeping both outer entrance arches readable. Show depth through the layered weave to the far doorway. Simulate a well-exposed tripod photograph with the entire architectural form in sharp focus, realistic tube diffusion and subtle light spill onto the existing floor. Preserve dark woodland and tactile ground detail. Reduce low-light noise and compression softness without waxy smoothing, artificial edge halos or plastic rendering. Control highlights to preserve individual LED lines and restrained color separation. Keep the scale and topology of the real structure; no extra arches or ribs, no added spectators, no changes to people or faces, no embellishments, text or watermark. Produce one image, not a comparison or collage.

name: 03-canopy-detail
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural, photographic alternate preserving a real artwork.
Asset type: landscape editorial architectural detail photograph, ideally 3840 × 2160 at the highest available native resolution.
Input image 1 is the primary edit target, an upward view inside the actual Kagora light pavilion. Input image 2 is supporting reference for the structure, not a second scene to combine.
Create a more striking, sharply focused alternate of this upward photograph. Preserve the actual curved tube paths, layered crossing order, joint positions, tube thickness, colored light segments and central tree trunk as closely as possible. Frame a slightly tighter landscape crop of the luminous weave overhead, allowing the sweeping curves to reach the frame edges and cropping the very bottom service structures out naturally. Keep the woodland canopy and patches of deep blue evening sky between the arches.
Bring out precise architectural detail and the translucent diffusers, with rich but credible cyan, pink, violet and pale warm light. Crisp depth of field throughout the tubes, subtle photographic texture, controlled highlights, dark natural foliage with readable depth. Strong graphic composition from the existing curves, not a redesigned pattern. Do not add, remove or remap structural ribs or invent starbursts, light beams, stars, people, text or logos. No excessive glow, painterly smoothing, CGI finish or collage. One complete landscape image.

name: 04-finished-pavilion
prompt: Edit this photograph of the actual Kagora woven LED pavilion in the woods. Make a beautifully focused architectural night photograph, in landscape 16:9 at the highest native resolution available. Preserve the real low, broad form, the exact arch groups, number of ribs, tube thickness, crossings, ground supports, tree positions and the few visitors inside; do not redesign or idealize the architecture or change people. Tighten and level the composition so the complete structure fills roughly 80% of the frame width, with comfortable edges and less empty ground below. Preserve the original white, cyan, blue, violet and warm yellow light pattern. Recover clear separation between glowing tubes, with controlled highlights and realistically diffused LEDs, a clean dark woodland background, sharp natural bark and leaf-litter texture, balanced shadows, subtle luminous color spilling on the floor. Refine noise and focus without crunchy halos or plastic surfaces. Keep the photograph's atmosphere and honest construction details, including visible joints. The goal is a polished photographic AI alternate with clearer focus and stronger framing. No extra ribs, no invented lights, mist, ornaments, stars, lasers, objects or people; no text, watermark, graphic overlay or collage.

name: 05-woven-detail
prompt: Edit the supplied close-up photograph of Kagora's actual woven LED tubes. Produce an impressive, precisely focused architectural detail, portrait 3:4 composition at highest native resolution available. Keep this exact diagonal weave, the number and position of tubes, crossing order, existing connector locations, thickness, slight physical bends and the black spaces between them. Keep the same perspective and overall framing, with tubes continuing beyond frame edges. Preserve the dark cobalt blue, violet, pink and cyan palette and the rainbow gradient along the tube at the lower right. Refine the focus and translucent material detail so the diffusers and real small joints are crisp, each luminous edge well separated, rich colored light against deep black. Smooth only image noise and compression artifacts, not genuine construction detail. Keep realistic light falloff and a restrained photographic finish. Match a sophisticated portfolio of a real light installation, not a perfect CGI lattice. Do not add, remove, rearrange or straighten structural lines, invent markings or light points, make tubes thicker, add bloom halos, people, scenery, text or logos. One image, not a collage.

name: 06-curved-interior
prompt: Refine this photograph of the actual curved interior of Kagora, a woven LED pavilion in the woods. Create a sharper and more striking portrait 3:4 architectural detail at the highest native resolution available. Preserve the exact viewpoint and all actual arch and rib paths: the sweeping cyan-blue outer curve above, magenta curves at the left, and thin interlaced diagonal bands through the center. Keep the real ground supports, connector positions, tube thickness, natural asymmetries and background tree. Frame slightly tighter to concentrate on the central sweep and crossing, cropping the umbrella at lower right and the distracting blurred foreground tube out of the frame naturally if possible, without changing the artwork. Keep electric cyan, cobalt, violet, pink and pale green in the existing pattern, precise tube diffusion and clean highlight separation. Improve low-light focus, reduce noise, reveal subtle floor reflections and dark woodland depth, avoiding oversharpened halos or waxy surfaces. This should look like a carefully exposed real architectural photograph of this same work. Do not redesign the weave, add or remove structural ribs, invent new supports or arches, add people, stars, mist, light rays or decoration. No text or logos, no collage.
refinementPrompt: Make one precise photographic cleanup to this image: remove the two black boots standing on the floor at the lower center, immediately in front of the wooden arch base. Fill only their footprints and silhouettes with a seamless continuation of the existing dark interlocking floor mats, the visible wood support behind them and the naturally colored light reflections. Preserve all LED tube geometry, the complete light weave, all supports, tree, colors, shadows, composition, crop and focus exactly. Add no objects or people. Keep the same portrait 3:4 image, at the highest native resolution available. This is a localized cleanup only.
